Permission to purchase an apple.

text_block_list.text:
Based on my previously accumulated
data, I have
determined that apples are
suitable for increasing
motivation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon

Once my
mood is refreshed, I will fully
devote myself to
training.

We buy apples as per Mihono Bourbon's
request
and make plans to get a fresh
start training for
the next race.
